map.容量 = ((紧凑 88 / 全尺寸 112) + 16L) × L bit；纠: Capacity = ((88 compact / 112 full) + 16L) × L bits; EC words ≈ floor(data bits × rate / 100) + 11; side length = 11 + 4L (compact) or 14 + 4L + reference grid (full), where L is the layer count
map.高电平编码先按 UPPER / LOWER / DIGIT / MIXED /: High-level encoding picks the shortest bit string across the UPPER / LOWER / DIGIT / MIXED / PUNCT tables by dynamic programming, inserts separator bits per code word, adds Reed-Solomon parity (GF(64) compact, GF(256) full, GF(16) for the mode message), then spirals the data bits along all four edges around a central bullseye. Layer count and parity words are derived from the payload, never from a pseudo-random fill. The encoder is ported from ZXing (Apache-2.0) and matches its official unit-test vectors bit for bit.
map.票据与登机牌：Aztec 靠中心靶心定位、不需要静区，同样内容占用的印刷面积更小: Tickets and boarding passes: Aztec is located by its central bullseye and needs no quiet zone, so the same payload occupies less printed area.
map.物流与工单标签：内容含校验字段时，可按 23%–50% 选择纠错比例，容忍油污与: Logistics and work-order labels: pick a 23%–50% correction rate to survive smudges and creases.

map.Aztec 和 QR 有什么区别？: How is Aztec different from QR?
map.Aztec 以中心同心方靶心定位、不需要静区，紧凑型 4 层以内即可容纳多数票据: Aztec is located by a central concentric square bullseye and needs no quiet zone; up to 4 compact layers cover most ticket payloads. QR uses three corner finder patterns and has a much wider reader ecosystem. Both are 2D matrix codes.
map.能存多少字符？: How much data can it hold?
map.容量由层数决定：紧凑型 1 层约 11 个数据码字，紧凑型最多 4 层、上限 6: Capacity depends on the layer count: compact layer 1 holds about 11 data words, and compact symbols top out at 4 layers / 64 data words. Beyond that the tool switches to a full-range symbol with up to 32 layers. Longer text means a larger symbol, and overflowing the maximum reports an explicit message instead of truncating silently.
